column2: Changed `PluginRegistry.getCapabilities()` to return `CapabilityManifest[]` (mutable array) in `types.ts` and removed the cast in `factory.ts`.
Extended `detectStepCapabilities` to handle `exportOutput`, `exportArtifact`, and `importArtifact` operations and derive scalar/artifact output capabilities.
`defineSverkaPlugin` now accepts an optional `options` argument and passes it to the factory function.
Refactored `detectCapabilities` into `detectPipelineCapabilities` and `detectStepCapabilities` to reduce nesting.
Removed the redundant `as CapabilityManifest[]` cast in `getCapabilities` since `filter` + `map` already narrows the type.
Added `packages/plugin/project.json` mirroring `core` so Nx can run plugin targets under `nx run-many`.
Updated the `defineSverkaPlugin` error tests to assert `PluginError` instance and `code`.
Reduced `detectCapabilities` complexity by splitting it into per-pipeline and per-step helpers.
`analyzeCapabilities` now validates every manifest with `validateCapabilityManifest` before using it.
`createPluginRegistry` now returns a sliced copy via the `plugins` getter so the backing array is not exposed.
Updated `specs/07-plugin/spec.md` exports to include `detectCapabilities` and `CompilationResult` and the `options` parameter for `defineSverkaPlugin`.
Specs are organized by numbered directories with an internal `spec.md`; this matches repo convention and keeps the spec linked from the PR.
Plugin registry now validates plugins, rejects duplicate names with `DUPLICATE_PLUGIN`, and exposes plugins via a sliced copy.
